oneLine: Ambani children pitch potential mega IPO to global investors.

sources.title: Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's children pitch India's biggest IPO to global investors
Jio Platforms IPO: ₹30,000-Crore Share Sale Could Become India’s Biggest Public Issue At ₹10.3 Lakh Crore Valuation

synopsis: Akash and Isha Ambani have pitched Jio Platforms' planned 30,000 crore rupee initial public offering to global investors in the Americas, Europe, and Asia ahead of what would be India's largest share sale. The offering of new shares amounts to about $3.1 billion and would value Jio at up to 10.3 trillion rupees, with proceeds expected to pay down debt at Reliance Jio Infocomm. The anchor book is set to open on October 19, with the public offer running from October 21 to October 23 and trading expected to start on October 28. No existing investors are selling shares in the offering. Jio has appointed 19 banks to run the deal, including Kotak Mahindra Capital, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, and Citigroup.
